claim.quote: Improved limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering cross section are extracted from this first period.

key_value_text.note: The paper states its limit as a plotted curve of WIMP-proton coupling against WIMP mass (Fig. 6) and gives no single number in the text, so `key_value` stays empty. The limits rest on 'three independent large data sets adding up to 52 kg-days of exposure' (main text, 'Improved sensitivity to WIMP couplings'), not on the 'exposure in excess of 250 kg-days' of the abstract, which the record used as its key value until 2026-10-28.
key_value_text.quote: Couplings above the line would have produced signals above observed backgrounds and are excluded to 90% C.L.
key_value_text.value: Spin-dependent WIMP-proton couplings above the curve of Fig. 6 are excluded at 90% C.L.

name: Improved Spin-Dependent WIMP Limits from a Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: The first dark-matter search with a bubble chamber: 1.5 kg of superheated CF3I in a Fermilab neutrino tunnel gave improved limits on how strongly dark matter particles could couple to the spin of the proton.
summary.technical: 1.5 kg CF3I room-temperature bubble chamber at the 350-ft level of the NuMI tunnel; exposure in excess of 250 kg-days with a live-time fraction reaching 80% (the limits use three data sets adding up to 52 kg-days); rejection factor for photon-induced electrons of ~1e-10; improved limits on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section (Science 319, 933, 2008).

title: Improved Spin-Dependent WIMP Limits from a Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract says bubble chambers had fallen into disuse and that this work illustrates their use in a new realm, the search for dark matter particles.
